errors.evidence: The blue line with x markers corresponds to the urban single/two-family houses series, but the description later uses only one blue line and omits the distinct blue series and legend mappings, leading to incorrect mapping overall for the multiple blue series.
The series described as green/urban multi-family houses does not rise to 20% in 1995; the urban circle-marked series is around 16-17%, and the green rural dotted series is around 11-12%.
No plotted series follows this trajectory for the described green line; the values shown in the figure for the corresponding series are much lower and do not peak at about 25% around 2000.
The described line does not show this value/path in the figure; the relevant series remain roughly around 10-12% (green rural lines) or around 20-23% (blue urban square series), but not as stated.
The description omits the legend’s actual color/marker coding: blue x, blue open circles, blue triangles, blue squares, green dotted line, and solid green line.
The description does not clearly state the chart’s specific subject as long-term residential location preferences in West Germany; it only gives a partial generic summary of housing types over time.
